## Background

Apply #8368 at `8919e7e7e51f85d50f3e2c9ffd61dd4a5f2b6e56` to main, as requested.

## What changed

Copy `.github/autobot/review-config.yml` unchanged from the source PR, enabling comment-only automatic reviews when a PR becomes ready.

## Details

Only the review-policy file changes. Product code, dependencies, workflows, and tests remain unchanged. Do not merge automatically.

- Signed-off commit cryptographically verified; guarded push succeeded and remote full SHA matched.
- Native formatter/pre-commit selections exclude this YAML; no Python files changed.
- Training/GPU tests excluded: no product execution changes.
- Full repository CI: unverified. External CI-Events parser coverage remains unavailable through session access policy.

detail.title: ci(autobot): AUT-2600 enable comment reviews on ready transitions

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+# .github/autobot/review-config.yml
+auto-review:
+  enabled: true
+  mode: comment
+  on: status_change
+  when: ready_for_review
